title: Code: Law of Large Numbers in action

cues.en: Instructor: In this video, we are going to explore the law of large numbers in code.
cues.zh: 講師：這部影片用程式探索大數法則。

cues.en: So let's start, this is gonna be a pretty exciting video.
cues.zh: 開始吧，這會很精彩。

cues.en: I'm looking forward to this one.
cues.zh: 我很期待。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm going to start by creating a weighted die or a loaded die, an unfair die, the probabilities of the different sides,
cues.zh: 先建立一個加權、動過手腳、不公平的骰子，這些是各面的機率，

cues.en: so this is face one, face two, face three, and so on.
cues.zh: 這是第一面、第二面、第三面，依此類推。

cues.en: So you can see that the probability of rolling a one is a quarter, which here I'm writing out two eighths just to make the math look a little bit simpler.
cues.zh: 擲出 1 的機率為四分之一，這裡寫成八分之二，讓數學看起來簡單一些。

cues.en: And the probability of rolling a two is also two eighths or one quarter.
cues.zh: 擲出 2 的機率也是八分之二，或四分之一。

cues.en: And then the other ones are all each one eighth.
cues.zh: 其他每個都是八分之一。

cues.en: And then, okay, we need to make sure that this is really a true probability.
cues.zh: 必須確保這確實是真正的機率。

cues.en: So it has to sum to one.
cues.zh: 所以總和必須為 1。

cues.en: So that's just a little bit of confirmation, a bit of sanity checking.
cues.zh: 這只是做一點確認、合理性檢查。

cues.en: Here I compute the expected value.
cues.zh: 這裡計算期望值。

cues.en: By the way, this is all stuff that I've shown you before in the video on expected value.
cues.zh: 這些都是之前期望值影片展示過的。

cues.en: So the expected value is the value times the probability, plus the value times the probability, plus the value times the probability, blah, blah, blah, all the way up to the end.
cues.zh: 期望值是數值乘以機率，加上數值乘以機率，再加數值乘以機率，一直到最後。

cues.en: So we see that the expected value of this die is three.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個骰子的期望值為 3。

cues.en: And now what I'm gonna do is generate a population and we're gonna sample from this population.
cues.zh: 現在產生一個母體，再從中抽樣。

cues.en: So the way that I'm doing this is by generating or starting with a vector of all the possible outcomes based on our probabilities.
cues.zh: 做法是，先根據機率，建立包含所有可能結果的向量。

cues.en: So the probability of rolling a one and a two are each twice as likely as the probability of rolling a 3, 4, 5, or 6.
cues.zh: 擲出 1 和 2 的機率，分別都是擲出 3、4、5、6 的兩倍。

cues.en: And then what I do is basically just loop through 20 times and keep concatenating this vector onto itself.
cues.zh: 再用迴圈重複 20 次，不斷將這個向量和自身串接。

cues.en: Now this may not seem like a lot, but this ends up being a huge, huge number.
cues.zh: 看起來也許不多，但最後會變得非常非常大。

cues.en: So let's see, this ends up being, what is this, 8 million data points in this data set here.
cues.zh: 看看，這是多少，資料集中有 800 萬個資料點。

cues.en: So we're considering this our population.
cues.zh: 把它當成母體。

cues.en: So we have the number of elements in the population is a little over 8 million.
cues.zh: 所以母體元素數略多於 800 萬。

cues.en: And now what I'm gonna do is draw a random sample of eight rolls.
cues.zh: 現在隨機抽一個樣本，代表擲八次骰子。

cues.en: So I randomly sample from this population, eight individual points.
cues.zh: 從母體隨機抽八個個別資料點。

cues.en: So it's basically like I'm rolling the die eight times.
cues.zh: 基本上就像擲八次骰子。

cues.en: So here is our sample.
cues.zh: 這是樣本。

cues.en: And then it's interesting to see what is the mean of this sample.
cues.zh: 看看樣本平均值，會很有趣。

cues.en: So let's say the mean of this sample is 2.7.
cues.zh: 假設平均值是 2.7。

cues.en: So it is certainly smaller than the expected value, although it's not so much smaller.
cues.zh: 肯定比期望值小，但也沒有小很多。

cues.en: But again, this highlights the difference between the expected value, which is always gonna be three, and the mean, which is going to vary on each sample.
cues.zh: 這再次凸顯期望值和平均值的差異；期望值永遠是 3，平均值則隨樣本變動。

cues.en: So this particular time it ended up being 2.75.
cues.zh: 這次剛好是 2.75。

cues.en: Let's run this again actually and see if we get something else.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，看看能否得到別的。

cues.en: So mean, so now it ended up being 3.5.
cues.zh: 取平均，現在是 3.5。

cues.en: So now in fact the mean of this sample is larger than the expected value, okay?
cues.zh: 這次樣本平均值反而比期望值大，好嗎？

cues.en: But this is a small number and we are looking at the law of large numbers.
cues.zh: 但數量很小，而我們研究的是大數法則。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do here is draw larger and larger samples.
cues.zh: 所以現在抽取越來越大的樣本。

cues.en: So the way that I do this is by looping over 5,000 and I say give me, well i random integers, random indices
cues.zh: 做法是跑 5000 次迴圈，每次要 i 個隨機整數、隨機索引，

cues.en: at each iteration, and then take the average of that sample.
cues.zh: 再對那個樣本取平均。

cues.en: So, so when i equals one for example, this just ends up being a single number, which means that our sample, so then we're drawing from the population,
cues.zh: 例如 i=1，最後只有一個數字，也就是從母體抽樣時，

cues.en: just that one sample.
cues.zh: 只抽這一個。

cues.en: So now our sample size equals one, not a very good scientific experiment, but you know, we're just getting started.
cues.zh: 樣本大小為 1，不算很好的科學實驗，但才剛開始。

cues.en: And then when k or when i equals 10, then this ends up being 10 numbers.
cues.zh: 當 k，或 i=10 時，就會得到 10 個數字。

cues.en: And so we're averaging over a random sample of 10 rolls from this population.
cues.zh: 也就是對從這個母體隨機抽出的 10 次骰子結果取平均。

cues.en: Okay, and so on up to 5,000, and then I'm going to plot this.
cues.zh: 依此類推，一直到 5000，再畫圖。

cues.en: Okay, so here you see the expected value in red and the sample averages in black.
cues.zh: 紅色是期望值，黑色是樣本平均值。

cues.en: Now you do see that as the number of samples increases, we're starting to get smaller and smaller, the variance gets smaller and smaller in these means.
cues.zh: 樣本數增加時，可以看到這些平均值的變異越來越小。

cues.en: So we're getting a little bit closer to the expected average compared to when we have a relatively small number of samples all the way down here.
cues.zh: 相較於這裡樣本數很少時，逐漸更接近期望平均。

cues.en: Now this is still not the law of large numbers.
cues.zh: 但這還不是大數法則。

cues.en: The law of large numbers is not about sample sizes.
cues.zh: 大數法則不是在談樣本大小。

cues.en: The law of large numbers is about the average over many samples.
cues.zh: 而是在談許多樣本的平均。

cues.en: And that average is going to better and better approximate the true population mean.
cues.zh: 這個平均會越來越好地逼近真正母體平均值。

cues.en: So that's what I do down here.
cues.zh: 下面做的就是這件事。

cues.en: So I say now the average of all of these black points here, and that is 3.0011.
cues.zh: 取所有黑點的平均，得到 3.0011。

cues.en: So in fact, even though all of these sample averages are, you know, kind of bouncing around, there's some variability, they never really converge to the expected value.
cues.zh: 所以，即使所有樣本平均值仍在波動、有變異，沒有真正收斂到期望值，

cues.en: The average of all of these sample means is extremely close.
cues.zh: 所有樣本平均值的平均，卻極其接近。

cues.en: It's off by one 1000th, so that's really, really close.
cues.zh: 只差千分之一，真的非常接近。

cues.en: And you can also see that visually here, you know, you can see that if you would just kind of visually with your brain's visual system, try to average these black lines together, you'd see
cues.zh: 從視覺上也可以看到，如果用大腦的視覺系統，試著將黑線一起平均，

cues.en: that they get really, really close to that red line, okay?
cues.zh: 就會發現非常接近紅線，好嗎？

cues.en: And here what I wanna show is even, so the law of large numbers even works for like small numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡想展示的是，大數法則甚至對小數量也有效。

cues.en: So even just averaging together the first 10 of these sample averages is already, you know, respectably close.
cues.zh: 即使只平均前 10 個樣本平均值，就已經相當接近。

cues.en: I mean first 10 isn't a very large number, but we're already getting pretty close to the, pretty close to the expected value.
cues.zh: 前 10 個並不是很大的數量，但已相當接近期望值。

cues.en: Okay, so now I want to go back to code from a previous lecture.
cues.zh: 接著回到前一堂的程式。

cues.en: This was a lecture about sampling variability, the code for sampling variability.
cues.zh: 是抽樣變異那堂的程式。

cues.en: Now this code is almost exactly the same.
cues.zh: 這段幾乎完全相同。

cues.en: So we generate a large population of normally distributed numbers, enforce that they have a mean of zero.
cues.zh: 產生一個很大的常態分布數字母體，強制平均值為 0。

cues.en: And now you remember in that previous video I was taking larger and larger sample sizes, kind of like what we're doing here.
cues.zh: 記得前一部影片中，我取的樣本越來越大，有點像這裡。

cues.en: And we saw actually something very similar here.
cues.zh: 也看到很類似的結果。

cues.en: So instead what I'm doing here is keeping the sample size fixed and I'm just gonna repeat 500 experiments.
cues.zh: 這裡改成固定樣本大小，重複 500 次實驗。

cues.en: So, and then those, the means of each of those experiments get stored in this vector sample means.
cues.zh: 每次實驗的平均值，儲存在 samplemeans 這個向量。

cues.en: And then, let's see, I wanna plot just that stuff first.
cues.zh: 先只畫這些內容。

cues.en: So I'm gonna run all of this code.
cues.zh: 執行全部這段程式。

cues.en: So now you see the population mean, the expected value and all the sample means.
cues.zh: 這裡看到母體平均值、期望值，以及所有樣本平均值。

cues.en: Now these blue dots, these blue squares are not converging to the population mean, the variance isn't getting smaller.
cues.zh: 這些藍點、藍色方塊沒有收斂到母體平均值，變異也沒變小。

cues.en: And that's to be expected because the sample size is the same.
cues.zh: 這是預期中的，因為樣本大小相同。

cues.en: These are just 500 different repetitions, each with 30 samples.
cues.zh: 只是 500 次不同重複，每次有 30 個樣本點。

cues.en: And then what I'm going to do here is plot the cumulative average.
cues.zh: 接著畫累積平均。

cues.en: So I implement that as the cumulative sum divided by the, you know, increase in the number of experiments.
cues.zh: 實作方式是，累積總和除以不斷增加的實驗次數。

cues.en: So this is the cumulative average, and I'm gonna plot that down here.
cues.zh: 這就是累積平均，要畫在下面。

cues.en: So this is the law of large numbers in effect.
cues.zh: 這就是大數法則在發揮作用。

cues.en: So you can see that in the beginning we are still kind of off, but as we average more and more means together, we get closer and closer to the true population value.
cues.zh: 一開始還有偏差，但平均越來越多平均值，就越接近真正母體值。

cues.en: And certainly by 500 we are really bang on, we're really right on it.
cues.zh: 到了 500 次，確實非常準，幾乎完全吻合。

cues.en: And in this particular case, even after, you know, a hundred or so, we're getting really, really close.
cues.zh: 這個特定情況，即使約 100 次後，就已非常接近。

cues.en: Now, you might think it's weird that, you know, it's negative.
cues.zh: 也許你覺得負值很奇怪。

cues.en: We have this bias to be below the mean, but that's just by chance the way this worked out here.
cues.zh: 看起來有偏低的偏差，但只是這次結果偶然如此。

cues.en: So I'm gonna run this cell again and you'll see now it ended up being closer sooner and yeah, run it again.
cues.zh: 再執行儲存格，這次更早接近；再執行一次。

cues.en: Now it starts off with a positive bias.
cues.zh: 這次一開始是正向偏差。

cues.en: So yeah, you can see that this sort of bounces around a little bit.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它會稍微波動。

cues.en: It's a little unpredictable, but it doesn't take that many repetitions to get really, really close to the population mean.
cues.zh: 有點不可預測，但不需要太多次重複，就能非常接近母體平均值。

cues.en: So this is the law of large numbers in effect.
cues.zh: 這就是大數法則發揮作用。

cues.en: Okay, so the last thing that I want to do in this video, or at least before switching to python, is look at not just the averages of these sample means,
cues.zh: 這部影片最後，或至少切換到 Python 之前，想看的不只是這些樣本平均值的平均，

cues.en: but the distribution of these sample means.
cues.zh: 還有它們的分布。

cues.en: So here is, so the law of large numbers is really all about averaging these sample means together.
cues.zh: 大數法則其實完全是在談把樣本平均值再平均。

cues.en: But let's just consider how these are distributed here, what this distribution looks like.
cues.zh: 但現在看看它們如何分布、分布長什麼樣子。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna do here is take a histogram of all of these blue dots here and here's what that histogram looks like.
cues.zh: 對所有藍點畫直方圖，結果像這樣。

cues.en: And that is a pretty interesting shape, don't you think?
cues.zh: 形狀相當有趣，不覺得嗎？

cues.en: So I'm going to start here with the example that I showed in the lecture on expected value.
cues.zh: 先從期望值那堂展示的例子開始。

cues.en: So I'm gonna create a weighted die or a loaded die, an unfair die, and these are the probabilities.
cues.zh: 建立加權、動過手腳、不公平的骰子，這些是機率。

cues.en: So this is phase one, phase two.
cues.zh: 這是第一面、第二面。

cues.en: So this is rolling a three, rolling a four, and so on.
cues.zh: 這是擲出 3、擲出 4，依此類推。

cues.en: So I'm specifying that the probabilities, or the probability of rolling a one is a quarter, which here I'm writing out as two eighths just to make the probabilities easier to count visually.
cues.zh: 指定擲出 1 的機率為四分之一，這裡寫成八分之二，讓機率在視覺上更好數。

cues.en: The probability of rolling a two is also a quarter and the probabilities of these other ones are one eighth.
cues.zh: 擲出 2 也是四分之一，其他則為八分之一。

cues.en: Now we should confirm that these end up summing to one.
cues.zh: 應該確認總和為 1。

cues.en: If this is really a probability mass function, then they should all sum up to one.
cues.zh: 如果真的是機率質量函數，就應該總和為 1。

cues.en: So lemme run this code and just confirm that we get a value of one or a hundred percent total probability, here I compute the expected value
cues.zh: 執行程式確認得到 1，或總機率 100%；這裡計算期望值，

cues.en: and that's really just the sum of the value times the probability of getting that value.
cues.zh: 就是數值乘以取得該值的機率，再加總。

cues.en: So this is rolling a one times a probability of one, rolling a two times a probability of a two, rolling a three times the probability of rolling a three, and so on all the way up to six.
cues.zh: 擲出 1 乘以擲出 1 的機率，擲出 2 乘以其機率，擲出 3 乘以其機率，一直到 6。

cues.en: I'm also gonna print that out so we can see what is the expected value here.
cues.zh: 也把它印出來，看看期望值。

cues.en: And that is three.
cues.zh: 結果是 3。

cues.en: So the expected value of this weighted die is three.
cues.zh: 所以這個加權骰子的期望值為 3。

cues.en: Now what I'm doing is generating a population of die rolls.
cues.zh: 現在產生一個骰子結果的母體。

cues.en: And by the way, these are die rolls, not dice rolls because there's only one of 'em.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這裡是 die rolls，不是 dice rolls，因為只有一顆。

cues.en: One is a die, singular, plural is dice.
cues.zh: 單數是 die，複數是 dice。

cues.en: So I'm generating like a seed of a population here based on their probabilities of occurrences.
cues.zh: 先根據出現機率，產生類似母體種子的向量。

cues.en: So rolling a one and rolling a two are each twice as likely as rolling a 3, 4, 5, or 6.
cues.zh: 擲出 1 和 2 的可能性，分別都是擲出 3、4、5、6 的兩倍。

cues.en: So then what I do is take this seed vector and basically just keep concatenating it on itself for 20 times.
cues.zh: 再取這個種子向量，反覆和自身串接，共 20 次。

cues.en: Now this may seem like a small population, but this ends up growing really, really fast.
cues.zh: 看起來母體也許小，但成長速度非常快。

cues.en: As you'll see, I'm gonna print out, print n pop, the number of elements in the population
cues.zh: 等一下會印出 nPop，也就是母體元素數，

cues.en: and let me just, I guess I can comment this out.
cues.zh: 先把這個加上註解好了。

cues.en: Okay, so it turns out that there's actually over 8 million elements in our population.
cues.zh: 結果，母體其實超過 800 萬個元素。

cues.en: So there's over 8 million die rolls in our population.
cues.zh: 也就是母體中有超過 800 萬次骰子結果。

cues.en: Okay, so then what we do here is draw a random sample of eight of these die rolls.
cues.zh: 接著從中隨機抽出八次結果作為樣本。

cues.en: So this is just like randomly sampling from our population eight times.
cues.zh: 相當於從母體隨機抽樣八次。

cues.en: And now let's see what the average of this is.
cues.zh: 看看平均值。

cues.en: So the average is 2.75 and the expected value, maybe I should put this back in, print exp val.
cues.zh: 平均值是 2.75，而期望值，也許把這行放回來，print(expval)。

cues.en: So the expected value is three and the average from this sample is 2.375.
cues.zh: 期望值為 3，這個樣本平均值則為 2.375。

cues.en: Quite a difference, actually, this sample is quite a bit smaller than the expected value.
cues.zh: 其實差得不少，這個樣本比期望值小很多。

cues.en: So this also again highlights the difference, the distinction between the expected value, which is kind of a theoretical parameter of a population
cues.zh: 這再次凸顯期望值和平均值的差異；期望值算是母體的理論參數，

cues.en: and an average, which is an empirical estimate or an empirical calculation of a particular sample.
cues.zh: 平均值則是某個特定樣本的經驗估計、經驗計算。

cues.en: So we can run this again, obviously the expected value is never going to change and the sample mean can change quite a bit.
cues.zh: 可以重跑，顯然期望值永遠不變，但樣本平均值可以差很多。

cues.en: Okay, so this is not the law of large numbers, in fact, this is a very small number and it's only one sample.
cues.zh: 這不是大數法則，數量其實非常小，而且只有一個樣本。

cues.en: The law of large numbers tells us that as we repeat this experiment over and over and over again many times and we store these averages, then the average
cues.zh: 大數法則說，不斷重複這個實驗很多次，儲存這些平均值，則這些平均值

cues.en: of those averages will approach the true population average, which is three.
cues.zh: 的平均會接近真正母體平均值，也就是 3。

cues.en: Okay, so that's what I'm going to do here.
cues.zh: 這裡就要做這件事。

cues.en: So here I'm generating increasing sample sizes from this population.
cues.zh: 從母體產生越來越大的樣本。

cues.en: So the way this works is I specify a maximum number of samples and I start off with basically one sample.
cues.zh: 做法是指定最大樣本數，從基本上一個樣本點開始。

cues.en: So here, so when i is one in the first iteration of this for loop, then I'm going to generate one random number,
cues.zh: 這裡，在 for 迴圈第一次迭代，i 為 1 時，會產生一個隨機數，

cues.en: which is used as an index.
cues.zh: 用來當索引。

cues.en: So one random index, and then I draw one random sample from the population, compute its average, which of course is just equal to itself and then store that number.
cues.zh: 一個隨機索引，再從母體抽一個隨機樣本，計算平均，當然就是它自己，再存下來。

cues.en: And then the next iteration i equals, well i here this indexing variable will equal one in the second iteration, but then I'm specifying i plus one.
cues.zh: 下一次迭代 i 等於，這裡第二次迭代的索引變數 i 會是 1，但這裡指定 i+1。

cues.en: So then we get two samples and draw two samples randomly from the population and compute the average and so on up until we get to 5,000 samples in total.
cues.zh: 因此取得兩個樣本點，從母體隨機抽兩個點並計算平均，依此類推，直到總共 5000 個樣本點。

cues.en: Okay, so and then I'm just plotting, let's see, we plot the sample averages and we plot the expected value as a line.
cues.zh: 接著畫樣本平均值，以及一條表示期望值的線。

cues.zh: 先忽略這些數字，稍後再回來。

cues.zh: 這裡紅色是期望值，黑色是樣本平均值。

cues.en: Now on the one hand you do see that with increasing sample size, we are getting closer to the expected value.
cues.zh: 一方面可以看到，樣本大小增加時，逐漸接近期望值。

cues.en: That's not so surprising, but you can see we never really converge on the expected value.
cues.zh: 這不意外，但可以看到，並沒有真正收斂到期望值。

cues.en: It never actually converges down to the expected value.
cues.zh: 沒有實際收斂到期望值。

cues.en: Instead what's happening is that the variance is just getting a bit smaller as the sample size increases.
cues.zh: 反而只是隨著樣本大小增加，變異逐漸變小。

cues.en: So again, this is still not the law of large numbers, this is the law of small numbers, I guess, well, this is getting us set up to the law of large numbers.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這仍然不是大數法則，我想這是小數法則，好吧，是在為大數法則做準備。

cues.en: The law of large numbers is telling us that when we average all of these black points together, that average will converge to the true expected value,
cues.zh: 大數法則說，將所有黑點平均，這個平均就會很快收斂到真正期望值，

cues.en: the true population parameter very quickly.
cues.zh: 也就是真正母體參數。

cues.en: And that's what I'm doing here.
cues.zh: 這裡做的就是如此。

cues.en: So here I take the average of all of the sample averages, which is all of these black points over here, and you can see that that is really, really,
cues.zh: 取所有樣本平均值的平均，也就是這裡所有黑點，可以看到它非常、非常，

cues.en: really, really close to the expected value.
cues.zh: 非常接近期望值。

cues.en: It is off by one 10000th, so that's really close.
cues.zh: 只差萬分之一，真的很接近。

cues.en: And even when taking only the first 10 points, you can see that it's still pretty close.
cues.zh: 即使只取前 10 個點，仍然相當接近。

cues.en: It's certainly closer than, you know, most of our random guesses up here.
cues.zh: 肯定比上面大部分隨機猜測更接近。

cues.en: So even just the first 10 points is already getting us fairly close to the expected value, although when averaging 5,000 points,
cues.zh: 所以只取前 10 個點，就已相當接近期望值，而平均 5000 個點時，

cues.en: we get extremely close to the true value.
cues.zh: 就會極其接近真正值。

cues.en: Okay, so this is one illustration of the law of large numbers.
cues.zh: 這是大數法則的一種示範。

cues.zh: 快速複習，產生一個很大的常態分布隨機數母體，強制平均值為 0；當時

cues.zh: 這次不這樣做，改用大小為 30 的小樣本，做 500 次實驗，

cues.en: Here are all the sample means.
cues.zh: 這些是所有樣本平均值。

cues.en: Now, unlike in the previous example, these points are not converging down to the population mean, the variance of these blue points is staying the same
cues.zh: 和前一個例子不同，這些點沒有往母體平均值收斂；這些藍點的變異保持不變，

cues.en: as we increase the experiment number.

cues.zh: 這些都是獨立實驗，好嗎？
